mechanism: Propylthiouracil can cause agranulocytosis and hepatotoxicity while carvedilol may mask tachycardia symptoms; both drugs undergo hepatic metabolism with potential for increased carvedilol levels if PTU causes liver impairment.
action: Monitor liver function tests, CBC, and heart rate closely; adjust carvedilol dose if hepatic dysfunction develops; ensure adequate thyroid control to prevent carvedilol resistance.
